name: verizh
description: 字準 VeriZh - 本地運算、隱私優先、可審計的三地中文轉換工具

scripts.audit:csp: node -e "const {checkCsp} = require('csp_evaluator'); const fs = require('fs'); const match = fs.readFileSync('index.html', 'utf8').match(/content=['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]/); if(match) { const res = checkCsp(match[1]); if(res.length > 0) { console.error('CSP Vulnerabilities:', res); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('CSP Evaluator Passed'); } } else { process.exit(1); }"
scripts.test: npm run audit:csp && npm run test:unit
